# Synthetic Fixture Data

## Definition and contents

- Use this directory for deterministic checked-in domain and protocol examples.
- Let individual fixture input, expected, and negative-case trees inherit this guide.

## Ownership

- Keep maintained regression fixtures with the Operation.
- Preserve synthetic provenance and exclude actual notes, credentials, and production receipts.

## Use and maintenance

- Consume fixtures through hermetic tests under the parent test contract.
- Avoid adding per-fixture instruction files solely to document generated data.
